title: Installation and Operation of DVD (IP 2014)
bodyHtml:
System of Operation:

  • Insert the DVD
    1.In the Windows Auto Run dialog box select to run or explore the DVD, locate the double click “Bookviewer.exe” to start the application.
    2.You must be online to proceed with the registration.
    3.A registration dialog box will appear asking the user to fill up the details such as User’s Name, E.mail and Name of Organization.
    4.There is a field marked Serial Number. This number can be found in a sticker on the DVD Jacket (In case the sticker is missing, please contact us at ipclab@vsnl.net).
    5.Type this number in the field labelled “Serial No.”.
    6.Now press the “Authorize” button.
    7.If successful, a validation no. will appear in the right side of the window.
    8.Copy this no. and paste it in the field marked “Validation Key” and press “Register”.
    9.The user will now be able to view the books.
